records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone (stall_reasons). Maya never replied to four Wrenfield emails (bc9c39cd, 0e711f1a, 0d8ebe1d, 6902380b); her only engagement was one closed feature question. Pro plan and a team lead's interest give some chance, but silence plus 8 days left suggests low unaided activation.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks again for flagging the weekly summary email — as I mentioned, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and your ticket is now closed on our side.

In the meantime, the simplest first step is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Chidi
